impl.summary: Design a voice is built on both engines. Audio → Design a voice has starter chips (age, gender, accent, tone, pace), your own words, a test line, three takes and 'Save as voice'. Qwen3-TTS 1.7B runs on your GPU (oss-qwen3-tts) and on fal (qwen-3-tts); VoxCPM2 runs on your GPU only (oss-voxcpm2). A saved voice is an Element voice that keeps the take as its clip plus the model, the description and the take's line (characters.voice_json). Later lines reuse it on either engine: ComfyUI clones the clip and reads its line (VoxCPM2's 'ultimate' clone), and fal clones it in two steps (clone-voice, then text-to-speech with the embedding). After the first cloud line Fuobe keeps fal's embedding file on the element, so later lines skip the clone. Designed voices appear in every Element voice picker with what they were designed with. Mapped against the plan: none of it existed. Only the fal schemas were in the research (paid-model-apis-2.json), and one key field there was wrong; it is corrected. Element voices, VoicePicker, 'My voices' and the voice-change and TTS plumbing already existed and were extended, not duplicated. Six commits on the branch, all signed. Nothing pushed.

The Qwen3-TTS and VoxCPM2 model records got their HF revisions: Base fd4b2543, VoiceDesign 5ecdb673, CustomVoice 0c0e3051, VoxCPM2 32279eff. Fish Audio Drama 3 is recorded as considered, not built.

GenParams gains voiceDescription and voiceTranscript; GenInput gains voiceEmbedding; FieldMap gains voiceDescription, voiceTranscript, voiceEmbedding and cloneFirst. buildPayload maps them, the request schema accepts them, and the plan refuses 'Describe the voice you want'.

Cloud model qwen-3-tts ('Qwen3-TTS (hosted)'), generated by scripts/gen-cloud-models.py. It has a voice-design route and a tts route with cloneFirst, the 9 premade voices, a Language control, and pricing per 1k characters. The generator learned voiceDescription, voiceTranscript, voiceEmbedding and the cloneFirst route option.
fal adapter, src/server/providers/fal.ts: cloneVoice() runs a sample through clone-voice, waits on fal's queue, then sends text-to-speech with the embedding. submit returns meta.voiceEmbedding.

src/server/voices.ts: savedVoiceFor() finds the saved voice behind a voice sample (owner only; never inside a tenant). keepVoiceEmbedding() fetches the embedding from fal hosts only (https, at most 8 MB), stores it as an asset and sets it on the element.
generations.ts: a saved voice adds its line as the transcript and, on a route that takes one, its kept embedding. After submit, a new embedding is kept for the owner's runs only.

DB: one appended migration, 'ALTER TABLE characters ADD COLUMN voice_json TEXT', with the originals comment. voice_json was added to ASSET_REFS for characters. The elements server stores and reads it; a new clip drops the old clip's embedding and line.
POST /api/elements takes voice {modelId, description, transcript} only from a model that designs voices, for a voice element that has a take. The embedding is never taken from a request.

findings.title: Qwen3-TTS clone on your GPU fails whenever the voice sample has no transcript
findings.where: workflows/comfyui/tts-qwen3-clone.json (scripts/comfy/hand-built/tts-qwen3-clone.json) node 2; src/server/providers/comfyui.ts prepareWorkflow (voiceTranscript only set when present); manifest notes for tts-qwen3-clone
findings.detail: The graph uses AILab_Qwen3TTSVoiceClone_Advanced with reference_text "" and x_vector_only false. At the pinned commit d8122a8b, Qwen3TTSVoiceCloneAdvanced.generate passes allow_empty_ref_text=False to _voice_clone_generate, which raises ValueError('reference_text is required unless x_vector_only is enabled') when reference_text is empty and x_vector_only is false (AILab_QwenTTS.py L677-681, L1002). Only the Basic node allows an empty transcript. So oss-qwen3-tts's tts route fails for every recorded or uploaded sample in Speech (and for any picker that offers it), and for a saved designed voice whose clip was replaced (voiceAfter drops the transcript). The manifest note says 'empty = the pack allows it', which is wrong. tests/voice-design-comfy.test.ts only checks the case with a transcript.
findings.fix: When there is no transcript, set x_vector_only true. For example, bind a key to node 2's x_vector_only and set it in prepareWorkflow to !voiceTranscript, or default the graph to x_vector_only true and set it false when a transcript is bound. Correct the note, and add a prepareWorkflow test for the case with no transcript.

findings.title: Parallel cloud lines on a saved voice each clone the sample and can leave orphan embedding files
findings.detail: With numOutputs > 1 (or two runs at once) on qwen-3-tts tts with a saved voice that has no embedding yet, every job runs clone-voice. Every job then calls keepVoiceEmbedding, which runs saveFile before checking again whether an embedding is already set. Each losing job leaves a stored safetensors asset that nothing references. The cost is tiny ($0.0008/min), but the orphan files build up. To fix, check before saving, or delete the asset when the check fails.

findings.title: fal embedding host allowlist excludes storage.googleapis.com/falserverless
findings.detail: fal's own OpenAPI example output for clone-voice (and for speaker_voice_embedding_file_url) is https://storage.googleapis.com/falserverless/example_outputs/qwen3-tts/clone_out.safetensors. Live outputs normally come from *.fal.media, which the allowlist accepts. If a live clone ever answers on the GCS bucket, the embedding is silently never kept and every line clones again. The safety cost is low; the fix is to allow that host only with the /falserverless/ path prefix. Not verified with a live run (no fal key).

findings.title: Cloud price shown for takes rounds every take up to 1,000 characters
findings.detail: fal bills $0.09 per 1000 characters (billing_unit '1000 characters', verified on the model pages). The default 70-character test line is shown as '3 takes · ≈ $0.27', while the proportional cost would be about $0.02. This comes from the existing per-1k-chars helper (Math.max(1, ceil(chars/1000))), which every per-1k-character model shares, not from this branch. It is noted because Design a voice makes short lines its main use.

fix.finalSummary: Fixed the high finding. On the open engine, a Qwen3-TTS clone of a sample with no transcript (any recorded or uploaded voice in Speech, or a saved voice whose clip was replaced) used to make the pack raise. It now turns x_vector_only on and clones from the voice's timbre. With a transcript (a saved designed voice's take and line), it still does the full clone. Also fixed: parallel cloud lines on a saved voice no longer leave orphan embedding files, fal's falserverless GCS bucket is accepted for embeddings, and new tests cover the hosted-runs pool path and the account path.
